title: Scene photo
description: A plain photograph shown to the room: a passenger's phone snapshot or a wire-service press photo. The image slot 'photo' holds the AI scene; the template adds only a thin frame, an optional caption and a credit line, so no readable text is ever painted by the image model.

sceneBrief.description: Image prompt for the photo (used by the media stage, not printed). Describe the scene positively: subject, setting as the documents describe it, people and what they do, lighting, time of day. Screens are dark, frozen or unreadable from the distance; never quote on-screen text.
examples: Crowded airport concourse, passengers standing with rolling suitcases looking up at a row of dark powered-off departure boards, high ceilings, late morning light

style.description: phone = a passenger's snapshot (timestamp strip, slight vignette); press = wire-service photo (white border, serif caption, credit line). Defaults to the variant.

caption.description: Caption under the photo, in the voice of whoever shares it (a post, a newsroom cutline). One or two sentences.
examples: Passengers wait in Concourse A as every departure board goes dark on Thursday morning.

credit.description: Credit line: a handle for a phone photo, a photographer and outlet for a press photo.
examples: Photo: J. Ortiz / Akron Beacon Journal

location.description: Where the photo was taken, shown small in the strip (a documented area of the facility).

timestamp.description: Time shown in the phone strip or the cutline, as a phone or a newsroom writes it.

source.description: Where the photo surfaced (shown in the strip): a social handle, a station, a tip line.
